! Game text
| '''0 side — On The Verge Of Greatness'''<br />Deploy [Set 16] Death Star and Scarif systems, Citadel Tower, {{Errata hl|1=Commence Primary Ignition,}} and Shield Gate. For remainder of game, you may not deploy characters of ability > 4 (except Vader). Vader is power +2 and he (or a Star Destroyer he is piloting) may make a regular move to a battle just initiated. While this side up, once per turn, may ▼ a {{Errata hl|1=site (or Imperial trooper) to}} Scarif. Flip this card if Krennic or Tarkin on Scarif and Death Star orbiting Scarif.<br />'''7 side — Taking Control Of The Weapon'''<br />While this side up, your Force generation is +2 for each "blown away" Scarif site. Tarkin Doctrine is immune to Alter and, when it initiates Force loss, may take any one card into hand from Force Pile. Once per turn, if opponent's character just lost from your site, may place it out of play unless opponent loses 1 Force. Tarkin adds 3 to total of Commence Primary Ignition. Flip this card if you have no leaders on Scarif. Place {{Errata hl|1=this card}} out of play if Shield Gate not on table {{Errata hl|1=or if Death Star has been "blown away}}.{{Errata hl|1="}} || '''0 side — On The Verge Of Greatness'''<br />Deploy [Set 16] Death Star and Scarif systems, Citadel Tower, and Shield Gate. For remainder of game, you may not deploy {{Errata hl|1=Endor Shield, non-Imperial}} characters{{Errata hl|1=, or non-Imperial starships}}. {{Errata hl|1=Once}} per turn, may ▼ a Scarif {{Errata hl|1=battleground}}{{Errata hl|1=. Your non-unique Imperials, vehicles, and capital starships are deploy -1 (-2 if a Star Destroyer). Non-unique Imperials are forfeit +1}}. Flip this card if Krennic or Tarkin {{Errata hl|1=at a}} Scarif {{Errata hl|1=battleground site}} and Death Star orbiting Scarif.<br />'''7 side — Taking Control Of The Weapon'''<br />While this side up, {{Errata hl|1=A Bright Center To The Universe cancels opponent's Force drain modifiers everywhere. Vader may make a regular move to a battle just initiated. At Death Star, system it orbits, and sites related to either,}} your {{Errata hl|1=total battle destiny}} is {{Errata hl|1=+1 (}}+2 {{Errata hl|1=if your non-unique card with ability in battle)}}. {{Errata hl|1=During your draw phase}}, may {{Errata hl|1=retrieve a non-unique}} card {{Errata hl|1=with ability}}. Flip this card if you {{Errata hl|1=do not}} have {{Errata hl|1=a leader at a}} Scarif {{Errata hl|1=battleground site}}. Place out of play if {{Errata hl|1=Death Star or}} Shield Gate not on table.

== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern [[On The Verge Of Greatness / Taking Control Of The Weapon]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Words a later column removed are highlighted in the column before it. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[On The Verge Of Greatness / Taking Control Of The Weapon (Errata)]] shares the [[On The Verge Of Greatness / Taking Control Of The Weapon]] column. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
